## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 3, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kyle Jernigan_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I had and used the app for 6 years now and just uninstalled since the app keeps getting worse. Features that used to be free are now behing a paywall, logging in food is a job in and of itself when you have to "create" each food item yourself and fill in the macros (seriously, why would you take away the search function for pre packaged food or bar code scanning?), and the notifications around meal times to remind you to log your food are downright awful."
            2. _Afonso Queirós_, Aug 4, 2026, 2/5: "Please rollback the last update. The UX is worse now. When I use the "meal scan" it goes to a random meal (like before btw) but now I don't have the option to switch the logged food from one meal to another. It was already bad and now it is worse. I will cancel my subscription if you don't improve the "meal scan" usage experience."
            3. _Kirsten Spear_, Aug 4, 2026, 5/5: "This is the best app I've used for counting calories to manage weight loss. I cook most meals at home, so the recipe building option is really helpful. Also, you can use HSA money for the yearly subscription. The free option works, but if you use it regularly the ads are too annoying."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Aug 5, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _H Orhan_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
            2. _xXxMomokaxXx_, Jul 3, 2026, 2/5: "I've been using the app for years, albeit irregularly; many formerly free functions are now premiums like the food scanner. the app is also great buggy with the Garmin app :,)"
            3. _Mahdy Berriri_, Aug 5, 2026, 3/5: "The app was working pretty fine for its entire lifetime But for whatever reason, you decide to make a terrible and pointless update !! The app is almost unusable now!! I used to navigate it very easily, but now, all that muscle memory is lost A lot of horrible user experience features as well. Why on earth would I want to copy what I had for breakfast yesterday in today's diary ? that's a pointless feature ! it's also one click away so it's very easy to make that mistake Why ? just, why ?"
<!--/ir-theme-->
